faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical South Surrey condo?
faq.a: The cap sits above the middle of the combined attached market: the S Surrey White Rock Condos & Townhomes median sale price was $700,000 in September 2026 — $100,000 below the cap — though that median mixes townhomes with condos and White Rock with South Surrey, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical condo (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Where does the attached stock actually sit in South Surrey / White Rock?
faq.a: By September 2026 inventory, White Rock held 193 Condos & Townhomes listings, Grandview 146 and King George Corridor 131, out of 593 community-wide; the highest attached sales ratio was Sunnyside Park at 32% (9 sales on 28 listings). Those are combined condo-and-townhome counts, not counts of condos under the cap (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How do I get to the Canada Line from South Surrey without a car?
faq.a: TransLink's Route 351 runs from White Rock Centre via the South Surrey Park & Ride and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station, per its own timetable (effective June 8, 2026).

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.
